questions.stem: P and Q can complete a work in 16 days and 24 days, respectively. They begin the work together, but Q leaves after 6 days. How many more days will P take to finish the remaining work? A. ​ days B. ​ days
options: 6 days D. ​ days Answer: C Sol: ​ 7 ​4 1 8 ​2 1 10 ​3 1 Given: P = 16 days, Q = 24 days. Solution: Total Work = LCM(16, 24) = 48 units. Efficiency: P = 3, Q = 2. Work in first 6 days (P+Q): (3 + 2) × 6 = 30 units. ​ Remaining Work = 48 −30 = 18 units. Time for P to finish: ​ = 3 18 6 days. Final Answer 6 days
